---
title: "Common NCDB Pitfalls"
---

::: {.callout-note title="Teaching outline"}
This chapter introduces the workflow. Apply it with the reviewed variable map and study protocol; the analysis templates are components, not a validated turnkey pipeline.
:::


# Common errors

- treating numeric codes as continuous values
- mixing clinical and pathologic stage without a prespecified rule
- ignoring diagnosis-year coding changes
- failing to distinguish unknown from absent
- using overlapping predictors
- overadjusting for mediators
- interpreting association as causation
- starting analysis before cohort definition
- ignoring missing-data patterns
- failing to validate derived variables
- sharing restricted patient-level data
